unit.why: A short narrative: a madman comes to the tzaddik for healing, is told to study a mishnah, the tzaddik explains the remedy to R. David of Lelov, and the man is cured.

stories.start_quote: פ״א בא לפניו איש משוגע שנסע
stories.summary_en: A madman travels to the tzaddik to be cured. The tzaddik tells him to study Akavia ben Mahalalel's mishnah, then explains to R. David of Lelov that man as a microcosm holds all remedies but cannot find them because of pride, which this mishnah humbles. The man is cured.

quotes: איש משוגע שנסע אליו אודות חליו
וממשנה זו יכנע וימצא רפואתן וכן הי'
tags.why: The tzaddik cures a mentally ill man through a prescribed study.

quotes: איש משוגע שנסע אליו אודות חליו
tags.why: The sick man journeys to the tzaddik with a request.

quotes: וצוה עליו ללמוד המשנה דעקביא בן מהללאל
tags.why: Studying a mishnah is the prescribed remedy.

quotes: שמחמת גאותו שאינו יכול להשפיל א"ע
tags.why: Pride is given as the cause of the man's inability to heal himself.
Self-humbling is the mechanism of the cure.

quotes: וא"ל שכל הרפואות הם סמים המעוררים לחימום
ואחרי שהאדם הוא עולם קטן ויש בו
tags.why: The tzaddik gives a homiletic explanation of the remedy.

quotes: והי׳ שם הרה"ק ר' דוד מלעלוב. ושאלו ענין זה
tags.why: A fellow tzaddik, R. David of Lelov, asks the tzaddik about his remedy.
The cure succeeded, though it is framed as natural self-healing rather than a wonder.
The tzaddik receives a petitioner and gives him instructions.
